body.name: Listen
body.bio: Senior Android Engineer with 11+ years of mobile development experience and 3+ years in Flutter. Expertise in client architecture (componentization, plugin systems), performance optimization, and APM infrastructure. Key achievements include reducing Feed timeout rates from 1.5% to 0.3%, building full-stack APM monitoring platforms, and leading Flutter app development for securities trading at Rakuten. JLPT N1, BJT J2 certified, currently based in Tokyo, Japan.

experiences.title: Senior Android / Flutter Engineer
experiences.description: Lead developer for new securities Flutter app (60-person project site): architecture design, framework development, FIDO2 authentication integration, and Flutter version upgrades. Maintained Android stock trading app and conducted code reviews for team members.

experiences.title: Android Engineer — Mobile Infrastructure
experiences.description: Built mobile APM stutter/ANR detection SDK with optimized data reporting and aggregation. Created full-stack monitoring dashboards (React/AntDesign frontend + Spring Boot backend with RESTful APIs). Participated in Commerce SDK Redux-pattern refactoring and WeChat Mall App iterations.

experiences.title: Android Engineer
experiences.company: Hangzhou Yin'ai Network Technology Co., Ltd. (Duolu)
experiences.description: Established Feed monitoring system, reducing timeout rate from 1.5% to 0.3% and latency by 40%+. Led componentization (1+2 module mode + shell scaffolding) and plugin architecture (Shadow framework with auto-fallback). Built dev-stage performance tools and automated testing (44 Feed cases via AirTest).

experiences.title: Android Engineer
experiences.company: Hangzhou Qibei Technology Co., Ltd. (Qibei Bike / Dingda Transit)
experiences.description: Developed bike-sharing apps (Qibei Bike, Dingda Transit, Luban Operations) across 4+ major versions. Implemented hot-fix (Tinker), online performance monitoring (Matrix), MVP scaffolding, and reduced build time by 30%+ via Gradle optimization. Set up Jenkins CI pipeline with wireless ADB deployment.

experiences.title: Android Engineer

Developed PassSDK for unified B-side authentication with AES/JNI encryption. Built logistics development framework for multi-app scaffolding.
